name: z-vision-tracker
description: Multi-user personal vision, mission roadmap, fitness, journaling, global prayer times, Ramadan calendar, and calorie tracker monorepo.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @z-vision/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @z-vision/backend" "npm run dev -w @z-vision/frontend"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @z-vision/shared && npm run dev -w @z-vision/backend
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @z-vision/shared && npm run dev -w @z-vision/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @z-vision/shared && npm run build -w @z-vision/backend && npm run build -w @z-vision/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @z-vision/shared && npm run typecheck -w @z-vision/backend && npm run typecheck -w @z-vision/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @z-vision/backend && npm run lint -w @z-vision/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @z-vision/shared && npm run test -w @z-vision/backend && npm run test -w @z-vision/frontend
